description: This file contains a C# class 'GeneratedEventReporterGrain' implementing an Orleans grain for reporting and retrieving stream event counts, with methods for reporting results, getting reports, resetting state, and checking silo location. It manages internal dictionary structures keyed by stream provider and namespace.

classes.name: GeneratedEventReporterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain responsible for reporting stream event counts, retrieving reports, resetting data, and verifying silo location within the Orleans cluster.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reports dictionary upon grain activation.

methods.name: ReportResult
methods.description: Records a count result for a given stream identified by provider, namespace, and GUID.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report counts for a specified stream provider and namespace.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all report data to an empty state.

methods.name: IsLocatedOnSilo
methods.description: Checks if the grain is located on the specified silo address.
